    The label-aligned contragredient finite skeleton #

    Finite-dimensional contragredient duality sends the chosen right-module skeleton of A to a complete duplicate-free right-module skeleton of Aᵐᵒᵖ. We retain the same finite label type, so later dualization of a new mesh reverses its endpoints without introducing a second arbitrary relabeling.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.isAnnihilatedBy_primitiveIdeal_contragredient_iff {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (e : A) (M : FinitelyGeneratedCategory A) :
    IsAnnihilatedBy (primitiveIdeal (MulOpposite.op e)) ((QuotientSubmoduleEquidistribution.Contragredient.dualFunctor k Aᵐᵒᵖ).obj (Opposite.op M)) ↔ IsAnnihilatedBy (primitiveIdeal e) M

    A module is killed by AeA exactly when its contragredient dual is killed by the opposite primitive ideal.
